Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + pre-kick alignment: Orbit Analytics evaluation plan

Team —

Orbit is ready to kick a formal mutual action plan (MAP) next week. I drafted a starting MAP and an evaluation checklist (attached) and want to align internally before we loop in Orbit. Goals for the pre-kick: confirm owners (RACI), identify security/procurement asks to surface early, and agree the evaluation success criteria and timeline to close (they want a June decision).

Key notes in the draft:
- Week 0: kickoff + confirm contacts (they asked for a two-week cadence)
- Weeks 1–3: evaluation (sample prompts, latency/cost targets, qualitative quality checks)
- Week 4: procurement + contracting window
- Week 5–8: pilot / SLA run and final decision

Ask: please review the attached Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx and the Eval_Prompts_v3.md and reply with: 1) proposed RACI tweaks; 2) outstanding security/vendor evidence; 3) any red flags on the timeline.

I penciled a 30-minute internal sync on Friday 2/27 10:00–10:30 PT — if you can’t make it, add comments directly in the doc. I’ll incorporate and send a cleaned MAP to Orbit on Monday.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 36KB), Eval_Prompts_v3.md (text, 4KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + pre-kick alignment: Orbit Analytics evaluation plan

Stephanie —

Thanks for starting this. Quick thoughts after skimming Orbit_MAP_v1:
- RACI: suggest moving “integration validation” ownership from me to Laura (Platform) with me as consult — Laura has time and the right infra contacts.
- Timeline: their June decision target is tight if procurement needs a SOC2 + contractual addendum. Can we compress the pilot by running a parallel short-localization bench during Weeks 1–3? I can own the bench automation.
- Evals: add a quick smoke test that runs 50 sample prompts end-to-end for latency distribution and token cost estimate — we should include that metric on the MAP table.

I’ll mark up the Google doc with inline comments.

—Aditya

Stephanie / team —

Couple of procurement/security points to surface before we send the MAP to Orbit:
1) Orbit’s procurement contact requested SOC 2 Type II evidence and an outline of our data retention policy (they handle PII in some flows). We have SOC2_summary.pdf ready but procurement will want a short cover note summarizing what the report includes.
2) Data residency: they asked whether we support EU-only processing for a portion of the pipeline. We should flag that they may need a Private deployment or a Dedicated capacity option for compliance — that will change cost and timeline.
3) Contract clauses: procurement likely will ask for standard SLAs and incident response terms. Can Legal draft a short appendix? I can coordinate.

I attached SOC2_summary.pdf to this thread. Please add any other evidence items to the attachments list.

—Monica

All —

Agree with Aditya and Monica. Two quick additions from the evals perspective:
- Success criteria: recommend we include both quantitative (median latency <= 200ms for 95% of prompts at their target concurrency; cost per 1k tokens estimate) and qualitative (NPS-style assessor score > 4/5 on a 25-sample blind set).
- Controls: we should lock the prompt set and the scoring rubric before kickoff to avoid scope creep. I can own the rubric and run the initial blind scoring; need 2 FEs as graders from Orbit.

If folks are okay, I’ll add the rubric template to Eval_Prompts_v3.md and paste a short summary in the MAP sheet.

—Rishi

Thanks, team — great feedback. Quick summary & action items we aligned on in the internal sync: 

Decisions:
- Laura will be the owner for integration validation (R) ; Aditya = C.
- Rishi owns the evaluation rubric and blind scoring process.
- Monica will package SOC2_summary.pdf + a 1-page evidence cover note for Orbit and flag residency options.
- Stephanie (me) will consolidate and send the cleaned MAP to Orbit on Mon 3/1, and lead the external kickoff.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal to draft a short appendix for procurement (Monica to loop Legal).
- If Orbit requires EU-only processing for part of the flow we need to surface Dedicated/Private deployment options and updated pricing (affects timeline).

Next steps:
1) Laura: update the Integration row in Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx to reflect new ownership and add contact names by EOD Fri.
2) Rishi: add rubric and sample scoring table to Eval_Prompts_v3.md by Monday morning.
3) Monica: finalize the SOC2 cover note + attach SOC2_summary.pdf.
4) Aditya: set up the internal kickoff (Fri 10:00 PT) / I’ll record and circulate notes for any absentees.
5) Stephanie: send cleaned MAP + calendar invite to Orbit (cc: procurement, Katie, Matt) on Mon 3/1.

Meeting confirmed: Internal sync Fri 2/27 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

—Stephanie
